scope: All six current CSS font-family selector declarations in a controlled production-CSS component-reference fixture, actual memberMatch helper, all eight shared SVG families and actual archive confirmation type/enable/Cancel. External test-only Inter and Georgia webfont requests fail; the deployed stacks stay unchanged. Local generic monospace remains intrinsic. Three engines, two themes,320/1280. All API reads locally fulfilled and all mutations refused.
limits: Controlled readonly-field and legacy person metric/day samples are CSS family fixtures, not a claim to exercise Setup or an operational person calendar. No current TS/HTML caller was found for person metric/day selectors.

Eight-icon family fixture proves the shared helper under font failure, not every operational placement. Current source classification links placements to the same helper; original24actualshell/profile/referencecases remain separately bound.

Failed external Georgia FontFace does not remove an OS-installed Georgia family: width against the secondary Times stack is diagnostic, not an equality assertion. Actual serif labels must remain positive-width, visible, hit-testable and contained. Inter stack metric equivalence is still asserted.
No actual production external font dependency, physical device, native assistive technology, OS font removal or universal200%text scaling claim.
The real archive destructive control is enabled but never activated; only actual Cancel is executed. No backend request or persistence.
